title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Forwarding Gateway Helpers Work Item
summary: Add public static helper methods NormalizeToDoq and GenerateMessageId to DoqMessage for use by gateway implementations.
planned_changes:
- Add DoqMessage.NormalizeToDoq(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) that returns a new byte array with the DNS Message ID set to 0.
- Add DoqMessage.GenerateMessageId(ReadOnlySpan<byte>, ushort) that returns a new byte array with the specified Message ID.
- Add focused unit tests for both methods including boundary cases.
- Link the requirement-home, architecture, and verification trace artifacts for REQ-0024 and REQ-0025.
verification_plan: Run DoQ foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Message ID collision detection or uniqueness tracking.
completion_notes: Both forwarding gateway helper methods are implemented and tested. REQs 0024 and 0025 are now traced and verified.
